from manim import *
import numpy as np


class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject


class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout(
            "Sec 2: From Transformation to Matrix: The Standard Matrix",
            [
                "Any linear transformation has a standard matrix.",
                "Columns are images of basis vectors e1 and e2.",
                "For T(x,y)=(2x+y, x-3y), compute T(e1) and T(e2).",
                "T(e1)=(2,1), T(e2)=(1,-3).",
                "Matrix A = [[2,1],[1,-3]] represents T.",
            ],
        )

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#FFFF99")

        title_label = Text("Standard Matrix", font_size=28, color="#00FFFF")
        self.place_at_grid(title_label, "B3", scale_factor=0.9)
        self.play(Write(title_label), run_time=0.6)

        statement = Text(
            "T: R^n -> R^m has an m x n matrix A", font_size=20, color="#FFFF99"
        )
        self.place_at_grid(statement, "B4", scale_factor=0.75)
        self.play(Write(statement), run_time=0.6)

        # Grid on right side (small)
        origin = np.array([4.6, -0.8, 0])
        axes_lines = VGroup()
        for k in range(-2, 3):
            h = Line(
                origin + np.array([-1.5, 0.5 * k, 0]),
                origin + np.array([1.5, 0.5 * k, 0]),
                color="#CCCCCC",
                stroke_width=1,
            )
            v = Line(
                origin + np.array([0.5 * k, -1.5, 0]),
                origin + np.array([0.5 * k, 1.5, 0]),
                color="#CCCCCC",
                stroke_width=1,
            )
            axes_lines.add(h, v)
        self.play(Create(axes_lines), run_time=0.6)

        e1_arrow = Arrow(
            origin,
            origin + np.array([1.0, 0, 0]),
            buff=0,
            color="#4D9EFF",
            stroke_width=3,
        )
        e2_arrow = Arrow(
            origin,
            origin + np.array([0, 1.0, 0]),
            buff=0,
            color="#66FF66",
            stroke_width=3,
        )
        e1_label = Text("e1", font_size=18, color="#4D9EFF")
        e1_label.next_to(e1_arrow.get_end(), DOWN, buff=0.1)
        e2_label = Text("e2", font_size=18, color="#66FF66")
        e2_label.next_to(e2_arrow.get_end(), LEFT, buff=0.1)

        self.play(
            GrowArrow(e1_arrow),
            GrowArrow(e2_arrow),
            Write(e1_label),
            Write(e2_label),
            run_time=0.8,
        )
        self.wait(0.3)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#FFFF99")

        self.play(
            Flash(e1_arrow, color="#4D9EFF", flash_radius=0.5),
            Flash(e2_arrow, color="#66FF66", flash_radius=0.5),
            run_time=0.6,
        )

        hint = Text(
            "Columns of A = images of basis vectors", font_size=20, color="#FFFF99"
        )
        self.place_at_grid(hint, "B5", scale_factor=0.7)
        self.play(Write(hint), run_time=0.6)

        # Transformed arrows on the same grid (just add new arrows)
        te1_arrow = Arrow(
            origin,
            origin + np.array([1.0, 0.5, 0]),
            buff=0,
            color="#FFA500",
            stroke_width=3,
        )
        te2_arrow = Arrow(
            origin,
            origin + np.array([0.5, -1.5, 0]),
            buff=0,
            color="#CC66FF",
            stroke_width=3,
        )
        te1_label = Text("T(e1)", font_size=16, color="#FFA500")
        te1_label.next_to(te1_arrow.get_end(), RIGHT, buff=0.05)
        te2_label = Text("T(e2)", font_size=16, color="#CC66FF")
        te2_label.next_to(te2_arrow.get_end(), RIGHT, buff=0.05)

        self.play(
            GrowArrow(te1_arrow),
            GrowArrow(te2_arrow),
            Write(te1_label),
            Write(te2_label),
            run_time=0.8,
        )
        self.wait(0.3)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#FFFF99")

        # Fade old content to make room
        self.play(
            FadeOut(axes_lines),
            FadeOut(e1_arrow),
            FadeOut(e2_arrow),
            FadeOut(e1_label),
            FadeOut(e2_label),
            FadeOut(te1_arrow),
            FadeOut(te2_arrow),
            FadeOut(te1_label),
            FadeOut(te2_label),
            FadeOut(hint),
            FadeOut(statement),
            run_time=0.6,
        )

        formula = Text("T(x,y) = (2x + y, x - 3y)", font_size=24, color="#FFFF99")
        self.place_at_grid(formula, "B2", scale_factor=0.85)
        self.play(Write(formula), run_time=0.7)

        comp1 = Text("T(e1) = (2*1 + 0, 1 - 3*0)", font_size=20, color=WHITE)
        self.place_at_grid(comp1, "C3", scale_factor=0.75)
        res1 = Text("= (2, 1)", font_size=20, color="#99FF99")
        self.place_at_grid(res1, "D3", scale_factor=0.8)

        self.play(Write(comp1), run_time=0.6)
        self.play(Write(res1), run_time=0.5)

        comp2 = Text("T(e2) = (2*0 + 1, 0 - 3*1)", font_size=20, color=WHITE)
        self.place_at_grid(comp2, "E3", scale_factor=0.75)
        res2 = Text("= (1, -3)", font_size=20, color="#99FF99")
        self.place_at_grid(res2, "F3", scale_factor=0.8)

        self.play(Write(comp2), run_time=0.6)
        self.play(Write(res2), run_time=0.5)
        self.wait(0.3)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        self.lecture[3].set_color("#FFFF99")

        # Fade computations, keep formula
        self.play(FadeOut(comp1), FadeOut(res1), FadeOut(comp2), FadeOut(res2), run_time=0.5)

        # Draw a fresh grid for the final vector display
        origin2 = np.array([4.8, -0.8, 0])
        axes2 = VGroup()
        for k in range(-2, 4):
            axes2.add(
                Line(
                    origin2 + np.array([-1.4, 0.5 * k, 0]),
                    origin2 + np.array([1.4, 0.5 * k, 0]),
                    color="#CCCCCC",
                    stroke_width=1,
                ),
                Line(
                    origin2 + np.array([0.5 * k, -1.2, 0]),
                    origin2 + np.array([0.5 * k, 1.2, 0]),
                    color="#CCCCCC",
                    stroke_width=1,
                ),
            )
        self.play(Create(axes2), run_time=0.5)

        final_te1 = Arrow(
            origin2,
            origin2 + np.array([1.0, 0.5, 0]),
            buff=0,
            color="#FFA500",
            stroke_width=4,
        )
        final_te2 = Arrow(
            origin2,
            origin2 + np.array([0.5, -1.5, 0]),
            buff=0,
            color="#CC66FF",
            stroke_width=4,
        )
        final_l1 = Text("T(e1)=(2,1)", font_size=16, color="#FFA500")
        final_l1.next_to(final_te1.get_end(), RIGHT, buff=0.05)
        final_l2 = Text("T(e2)=(1,-3)", font_size=16, color="#CC66FF")
        final_l2.next_to(final_te2.get_end(), RIGHT, buff=0.05)

        self.play(
            GrowArrow(final_te1),
            GrowArrow(final_te2),
            Write(final_l1),
            Write(final_l2),
            run_time=0.9,
        )
        self.wait(0.3)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        self.lecture[4].set_color("#FFFF99")

        self.play(
            FadeOut(axes2),
            FadeOut(final_te1),
            FadeOut(final_te2),
            FadeOut(final_l1),
            FadeOut(final_l2),
            FadeOut(formula),
            run_time=0.5,
        )

        # Matrix A built from MathTex pieces with colored columns
        a11 = Text("2", font_size=28, color="#FFA500")
        a21 = Text("1", font_size=28, color="#FFA500")
        a12 = Text("1", font_size=28, color="#CC66FF")
        a22 = Text("-3", font_size=28, color="#CC66FF")

        col1 = VGroup(a11, a21).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.2)
        col2 = VGroup(a12, a22).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.2)
        cols = VGroup(col1, col2).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.5)

        left_bracket = Text("[", font_size=80, color="#FFFF99")
        right_bracket = Text("]", font_size=80, color="#FFFF99")
        left_bracket.next_to(cols, LEFT, buff=0.1)
        right_bracket.next_to(cols, RIGHT, buff=0.1)

        matrix_label = Text("A =", font_size=28, color="#FFFF99")
        matrix_label.next_to(left_bracket, LEFT, buff=0.15)

        matrix_group = VGroup(matrix_label, left_bracket, cols, right_bracket)
        self.place_at_grid(matrix_group, "D4", scale_factor=0.75)

        self.play(Write(matrix_label), Write(left_bracket), Write(right_bracket), run_time=0.5)
        self.play(Write(col1), run_time=0.5)
        self.play(Write(col2), run_time=0.5)
        self.wait(0.2)

        self.play(
            Flash(matrix_group, color="#FFFF99", flash_radius=3.5),
            run_time=1.0,
        )

        self.wait(1.5)
